institution.name: Nusantara General Insurance
institution.summary: Mid-size Indonesian general insurer: motor, property and engineering, marine cargo and hull, group health and personal accident, with a sharia (takaful-style) unit; sells through agents, brokers, motor dealers and banks, and buys reinsurance in Jakarta, Singapore and Europe.

segments.label: Vehicle owners
segments.note: Car and motorcycle owners insured through dealers, agents and banks.

segments.label: Small and medium businesses
segments.note: Shops, workshops and small factories with fire and all-risks policies.

segments.label: Industrial and mining corporates
segments.note: Mining, energy, plantation and manufacturing groups: property, engineering and liability, often placed through brokers.

segments.label: Importers, exporters and shippers
segments.note: Coal, palm-oil, commodity and general cargo owners and freight forwarders; they insure each shipment or buy open covers.

segments.label: Employees on group schemes
segments.note: Staff of employers who buy group health and personal accident cover.

segments.label: Pilgrims and travellers
segments.note: Umrah and Hajj pilgrims and holiday travellers; many depart through Jakarta, Surabaya and Makassar.

segments.label: Migrant-worker families
segments.note: Workers in Malaysia, Saudi Arabia, Hong Kong and Taiwan, and their families in Java and Nusa Tenggara.

segments.label: Farmers and plantation smallholders
segments.note: Rice, palm-oil and rubber growers under the subsidised crop-insurance scheme and private covers.
